title: There are better options
text:
There are better options. This is my second gaming chair I've purchased and this one I found lacking in every way. For one thing, the headrest is smaller than the pictures shown. Another issue I have with it is that the foot rest holes are misaligned slightly causing it to "extend" (and I use that term loosely) at an angle. I have to admit that this chair was slightly easier to assemble due to the chair being held up by it's main support by only gravity.
**EDIT: after attempting to disassemble I have to revise my opinion of the main support. I couldn't budge it if I tried... And I tried.**
